versions.changelog:
- Initial release of eric-ai-agents-architect skill.
- Provides expert guidance on designing, building, and optimizing autonomous AI agent systems.
- Covers agent architecture patterns (e.g., ReAct, Plan-and-Execute), dynamic tool integration, memory strategies, and multi-agent orchestration.
- Includes best practices for safety, error handling, logging, and graceful fallback.
- Offers implementation-ready code patterns and detailed tool schema recommendations for robust agent development.
